<h3 id="prefight"><nowiki>Prefight</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>This rotation requires you to teleport out after each kill to War's Retreat, where you should altar, bank, and then channel 100% adrenaline at the adrenaline crystals before entering the instance. Once you enter the instance, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644352871714836.png?v=1" alt="gsunshine" title="gsunshine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> once you see the base use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535533833391702017.png?v=1" alt="dbreath" title="dbreath" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
